subject: Budget range validation - ZenPay (post-call recap)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@zenpay.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Budget range validation - ZenPay (post-call recap)

Hi Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the key open items so we can align on pricing and procurement next steps:

- Expected monthly token volume: approx 100-200M tokens (you mentioned ~150M as the mid-point).
- Primary workloads: customer support chat + lightweight generation for notifications (average sequence length ~1k tokens / request).
- Unit economics target you called out: roughly $10-$15 per 1M tokens (internal target: $12/1M).
- Desired monthly spend band: you said the team is comfortable with an initial band -- please confirm if $15k-$40k/month sounds right.
- Procurement thresholds: we need to understand internal approval gates (e.g., purchases < $15k = self-serve/cc, $15k-$50k = PO via procurement, > $50k = legal review + SOW). Can you confirm ZenPay's thresholds?

Attachments: I'll share a compact pricing_breakdown.xlsx showing pay-as-you-go vs reserved/committed tiers and an initial SOW draft if helpful.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm the budget band and procurement thresholds in a reply.
- If thresholds allow, we can send a 30-day reserved-capacity quote to hit your unit economics target and route to procurement.
- Book a short 30-min follow-up next week to walk pricing options and procurement checklist.

Thanks - Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@zenpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@zenpay.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Budget range validation - ZenPay (post-call recap)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few items from our side so you have an accurate baseline:

- Monthly token volume: we're projecting ~150M tokens/month initially, with potential to grow to ~300M over Q1 depending on feature adoption.
- Unit economics: the product team is aiming for ~$10-$12 per 1M tokens to make the cost model work against our LTV assumptions.
- Monthly budget band: rough range for procurement is $18k-$30k/month in the first phase, with a possibility to expand to $40k/month if the reserved pricing is compelling.
- Procurement thresholds: procurement@zenpay.com says purchases below $20k are handled via corporate card/PO-less process, $20k-$50k require a formal PO and Procurement review, and anything above $50k will engage Legal for a reviewed SOW and insurance reviews.

We'd definitely be open to a committed/reserved option if that gets us closer to $10/1M. Can you send an example reserved quote and a short SOW with the standard SLAs? I'll loop in Procurement if you send the SOW and pricing doc.

Best,
Alex
Head of Product, ZenPay
alex.johnson@zenpay.com | (617) 555-4110
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Budget range validation - ZenPay (post-call recap)

Thanks Alex — great, that's helpful. I attached the pricing_breakdown.xlsx with two modeled scenarios and a short SOW draft (SOW_Draft_v1.pdf) for your procurement/legal to review. Quick highlights in the sheet:

- Pay-as-you-go: $18/1M tokens list, no commit, scales linearly - for 150M tokens = $2,700/month (note: this is illustrative, actual per-token charges break down across prompt+completion).
- 1-month reserved commit (medium): 100M commit -> effective ~$12/1M tokens (saves ~33% vs PAYG) - shows up as ~$1,800/month effective for committed capacity.
- 3-month reserved commit: better unit rate ~$10/1M when averaged over longer commit and upfront billing.

I also called out procurement thresholds you noted in the sheet and added a simple checklist for PO + SSO + security questionnaire items.

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll share the Drive link with the SOW + pricing (included above) and send a short quote PDF for your procurement team.
2) Can we book 30 minutes on Tue 11/10 to walk procurement and technical questions? I've tentatively proposed two slots; let me know what works.

If Procurement wants to loop in legal, we can provide our standard insurance/litigation docs and SOC 2 evidence as part of the SOW package.

Thanks - attaching files now.

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Looping Rishi for visibility - flagging the ask and recommended pricing path.

Notes for the sales plan: 
- ZenPay target unit economics (~$10-$12/1M) lines up with our 1-month reserved + moderate commit offering. If they can commit to ~100M for 1 month, we can price at $12/1M and meet their economics.
- Procurement thresholds are favorable: PO kicks in at $20k so our initial monthly quote (~$1.8k-$2.7k depending on model) sits well under the heavy legal threshold. 
- Next action: Marissa to send official quote + SOW to procurement@zenpay.com and I'll prepare a short approved discount memo (if needed) referencing DEAL-2026-0098.

I'll also draft the committed quote template and drop into the shared Drive folder so Marissa can attach for Procurement.

Thanks,
Dylan
